snippet.title: Astra Protocol 2 - Three Year Anniversary Patch
snippet.description:
Astra Protocol 2 turns three!

To celebrate three years of space exploration - and to thank our dedicated players -  we’re releasing the Astra Protocol 2 Three Year Anniversary Patch, bringing the game to version 2.0!

This major overhaul introduces:
- A brand new renderer, overhauling how the universe is drawn.
- Immersive new visual effects including enhanced CRT effects and radiation distortion.
- Smoother performance thanks to improved rendering and collision systems.
- A refreshed user manual.
- A whole load of other tweaks and refinements.

The Astra Protocol 2 Three Year Anniversary Patch is available as a free update to owners of the game on Steam and itch.io.

Haven't joined the mission yet? Now's the perfect time:

[Play Astra Protocol 2 on Steam] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2026750/Astra_Protocol_2/

[Play Astra Protocol 2 on itch.io]
https://slicebar.itch.io/astra-protocol-2
